decisions.reason: Swift is the tighter collocation for 속전속결 than quick.
무혈입성 is bloodless entry; take the place drops that image.
Keeps 굴복시켜야 한다 as obligation while merging the method clause.
decisions.replacement: If words and gestures couldn’t tame her, he would have to subdue her with violence—the same method Pung Yang had always used.

decisions.reason: Keeps 적풍단의 마적들 and 일제히; BASE dropped the band name, SOL dropped 마적.
decisions.replacement: Powerful horn calls rang out from every direction. At the advance signal used by the mounted-bandit groups of the plateau, the mounted bandits of the Red Wind Band surrounding the Mount Heng Sword Sect kicked their horses in the ribs as one.

decisions.reason: 두두두두두 is a sound effect, not a narrative beat about the ground shaking.
Source is 말발굽 trampling as they run; BASE makes them horses, SOL drops 짓밟으며.
decisions.replacement: Hundreds of hooves raced forward, trampling the snow-covered ground.

decisions.reason: Carrying strong is unidiomatic; strong and carrying far keeps 힘차게, 멀리.
Blank blockquote spacing is a wash; keep the established panel markup.
들리고 then 눈을 뜨자마자 is hear first, then open eyes.
항상 is temporal, not everywhere; the dash reads more like speech.
decisions.replacement: “There's always sound. Listen—the horses chewing hay, the wind…”

decisions.reason: It’s a thing matches 그런 게 있어 as a brush-off better than it’s something.
Gave up trying to explain is the natural English for abandoning the explanation.
Coincidentally… north, toward the sect is cleaner without the extra where-clause.
Too far away to hear it is more spoken than should have been audible from this distance.
Could’ve sworn is the spoken form for this line.
그러니까 is so/therefore, not and.
Based on what is more in Taekyung’s voice than on what grounds.
The inverted line lands Mukyung’s arrogance more naturally without changing the logic.
At a loss for words is the idiomatic reading of 말문이 막힌; rendered speechless is stiff.
다스리다 is control/composure, not mastering, which also collides with the rank term.
First clause naturalizes 평소와 다름없어; hardened veteran underplays 닳고 닳았다.
decisions.replacement: I only looked the same as usual because I had grown so accustomed to it. When it came to preparing for and taking part in battle, I was already thoroughly battle-hardened.

decisions.reason: Keep your movements to a minimum and you’ll be fine is more spoken for 문제없다.
Put effort into reforming is the more idiomatic collocation.
He couldn’t have done all that is tighter than those weren’t things he could have done.
Hyphenation only; no real prose gain.
Gazed sentimentally, almost a little moved naturalizes 감성적인 눈빛 and 약간 감동 without extra weight.
Eyes down matches the blunt 눈 깔아 better than lower your eyes.
상처 하나라도 is taking a wound, not a scratch from the bandits.
I must have captures the 했구나 self-realization.
Sidled over renders 슬쩍 다가온; the following line already supplies the speech.
Okay and fine are a wash; keep the established wording.
Why would you put it like that is the more flustered protest.
Make sure keeps 반드시; get ready is more spoken for 출발 준비나 해.
As he grumbled is tighter than while for the same simultaneous kick.
From here on is the natural narrator equivalent of 이제부터는.
Same System markup wash as H008.
Withstanding a siege naturalizes 수성; fitted with structures is less installation-calque.
Insistence weakens 강경한 의지; intended is extra on 제 역할.
decisions.replacement: Built more than thirty years ago under the uncompromising will of the founding Sect Leader, Lee Cheonbaek, those defenses were finally serving their purpose.

decisions.reason: Loosed in unison is the proper archery rendering of 일제히 쏘아진.
도 is sabers, but SOL drops 마적들 and 한 손 and widens 전투 into warfare.
decisions.replacement: But the most common weapons on the plateau were spears, sabers, and bows. Accustomed to fighting on the plateau, the mounted bandits of the Red Wind Band raised the shields strapped to one arm before anyone even gave the order.

decisions.reason: 낙마한 is fell from horseback; knocked adds an unstated impact.
Stopped the arrows admirably is tighter for 훌륭히 막아 냈다.
어르신들 is elders, not generic betters.
Hurtled improves 날아온; tremendous underplays 강맹한.
decisions.replacement: Something hurtled through the air with ferocious force, pierced the horse’s neck, and buried itself in the squad leader’s chest.

decisions.reason: SOL drops 일류 초입; BASE is faithful but choppy.
decisions.replacement: Having only just entered the early stages of First Rate, he stared at the arrow protruding from his chest as though he couldn’t believe it, then toppled over together with his prized horse.

decisions.reason: 쓰러진다 is fell; crashed down overstates it.
Barrage already names the arrow rain; dropping the extra arrow is cleaner.
On horseback, drew and loosed, fast and true is more native archery prose for 연거푸 시위를 당기는.
몸을 숨겨라 is hide, not stay.
대고 is set against, not threw or propped; anyway and scaling them recast 침투를 시도했다.
터져 나왔다 is burst; SOL invents blood spraying through the air.
decisions.replacement: Screams and blood burst forth.

decisions.reason: Don’t let them climb up is the sharper battlefield shout for 올라오지 못하게 막아.
Watched it all is tighter for 이 모든 광경 without losing scope.
Keep the established the Murim rendering.
The Korean is one comma-joined line; the standalone scream sentence should merge.
Joins the two noun phrases as in 비명, 몸부림.
SOL drops 마침내 맞닥트린 and intensifies 두려웠다 to terrifying, plus ever.
Were going to leave is clearer English for 떠날 이들은 than would leave.
Keeps 이끌어야 할 and 운명을 함께해야 in one sentence; responsible for softens the duty.
decisions.replacement: Lee Seowol was now the Sect Leader who had to lead them, and she was bound to share her fate with the Mount Heng Sword Sect.

decisions.reason: You must do something carries the urgency of 어서 조치를 as a shout.
Keep 빗발치는 as rained down; spoke naturalizes 입을 열었다.
decisions.replacement: As urgent reports rained down from every direction, Lee Seowol spoke.

decisions.reason: Both flatten 지키고 있던 to mere standing.
decisions.replacement: Cheol Mubaek, who had been standing guard beside her, answered.

decisions.reason: Needs both 따름입니다 and 어려운 부탁; each candidate keeps only one.
decisions.replacement: “I can only apologize for making such a difficult request.”

decisions.reason: Still is the more natural turn from praise to 허나 몸조심하세요.
The extra really/could heightens the rhetorical scoff in 당할 성싶으냐.
Laughed and leaped is one motion chain, not then.
Guarding the gate makes 문을 넘을 수 없을 concrete without adding a new action.
More. Just a little longer follows 더, 조금만 더.
Gazed down and shouting like a thunderclap keep 내려다보던 and 벼락같은 외침.
SOL drops 각각 and turns 활시위를 당겼다 into drew their bows.
환하게 빛났다 is shone, not blazed; the arrows are already specified.
떨어지는 is falling, not arcing; who stood is extra.
decisions.replacement: The fire arrows falling like meteors were clearly visible even to Pung Yang, more than a hundred *jang* away.

decisions.reason: 내심 중얼거렸다 is inward muttering; deleting the beat loses it, and thought is too weak.
decisions.replacement: He muttered to himself.

decisions.reason: 한 수 is a move, and So captures 있었군; ace is a different metaphor.
짐작 is a guess, not suspicion.
Burning alive is the natural English for this painful-death beat.
Keeps 마적들; in agony recasts 끔찍한 비명 as a feeling.
끊기고 is snapped; burned through names a cause the clause does not.
Keep 올라가기를 기다리던; SOL’s while-join is the better sentence.
decisions.replacement: Those waiting below to climb and those still climbing burned to death, while those who had already reached the top were stabbed and slashed by weapons converging from every direction.

decisions.reason: 나름 준비를 했다 is some preparations, not prepare after all.
응시 is stared; 곳곳이 is in patches.
decisions.replacement: As Pung Yang stared impassively at the battlefield, a mounted bandit returned, his body blackened in patches like charcoal.

decisions.reason: Our losses are too great is the more panicked spoken rendering of 피해가 너무 큽니다.
Breathlessly is cleaner than in a breathless voice for 헐떡거리는 목소리로.
사기가…… still wants the trailing is.
그럼 되었다 is that’s enough/that will do, not the matter is settled.
As he spoke is the natural reading of 말과 동시에.
Tilt is the right verb for a person; list is nautical.
Restores 어리둥절한 표정으로 굳어 가는, which BASE omitted.
Subject-first accustomed to such sights is more native than fronting the familiarity.
A little over 150 but not quite 200 is cleaner, and heavier losses is the collocation.
오죽하겠느냐 needs the comparative; 보루 is bulwark, not a generic last line.
decisions.replacement: “How much worse do you think theirs are? The men on those walls are the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s final bulwark.”

decisions.reason: Keeps the 못 믿는 건 아닙니다만 structure and the trailing 함정을……
그걸 노린 게지 is what they’re aiming/counting on, not what they want us to think.
실소 is a derisive laugh, not a chuckle, and 제법 needs quite.
물렸을 것이다 is would have, not might; less experienced is better English.
애쓰는군 is struggling, not desperate; 누군가의 지원 is someone’s support.
Could not fits the proverb, and no trouble matches 일도 아니다 better than would be easy.
직접 간다 is I’m going myself; in adds an entry the line does not make.
We have a tiger to catch is the more idiomatic rhetorical question for 잡아야 하지 않겠느냐.
더듬었다 is felt/groped, not reached; out of habit naturalizes 습관적으로.
decisions.replacement: Pung Yang burst into a hearty laugh and felt inside his robes out of habit.

decisions.reason: 단단한 목곽 is the case itself; brushed against adds a hand beat the fragment does not have.
단숨에 is in one go; a single blow names a strike the object does not.
